name: Legendary Pathfinding
body:
Your ability to find your way through the wilderness is legendary, even supernatural.

Prerequisite(s): Survival 10 ranks, 5th-level chronicler

Benefit: Once per week, you are able to gain the benefits of the find the path spell to navigate your way through an area of wilderness (but not a dungeon, urban area, or a plane that is not your native plane). Your caster level for this effect is equal to your chronicler level. When you attain 8 levels in the chronicler prestige class, you are able to use this ability one additional time per week. When you attain 10 levels in chronicler, you are able to use this ability without being restricted to wilderness areas.
